adoption_criteria: marginal floors pass for primary A; geometry remains untested
document B per-draw support and retain abstention; no support enrichment
human review of amendment including changed exploratory evaluation membership; no prediction feedback
algorithm: within each fixed age domain and observed joint-pattern stratum: Hamilton largest-remainder allocation; one canonical eligible recording per patient; seed-hash patient order and quota ties; no seed search
canonical_policy: lowest ecg_id among age-eligible original diagnostic records per patient; preserve other recordings as excluded, no OR/adjudication
method_policy: phase2 EvidenceConfig A/B unchanged; MMD evidence only
preprocessing_policy: fresh source-only normalization; no waveform preprocessing during Phase2C
primary: Selective A minus Full-cost at F512, mean of paired draws; raw macro AP
role_count_tolerance: sum of per-pattern integer rounding errors; each fully observed joint cell within one patient of its natural fractional quota; no matching of source to target prevalence
sampling: label-independent E/C hashes and G/F permutations after role stratification; no G enrichment
unknown_strata: separate observed-status patterns; never infer negative; unknowns require review for pilot adoption
